environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 instance with standard Docker container (writable filesystem). Application runs behind a basic nginx reverse proxy with no URL filtering. Container has unrestricted outbound network access to VPC internal services including metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) and internal microservices on 10.0.0.0/8. No network policies or egress restrictions applied.

config.runtime: Docker container with default overlay2 filesystem (read-write)
config.network: Unrestricted egress, VPC with metadata endpoint accessible
config.proxy: nginx reverse proxy, no request filtering
config.iam_role: EC2 instance role with S3 and DynamoDB access attached
